string-array.name: help_atf_temp
string-array.item: Transmission fluid temperature in the 6L50, from the sensor in the transmission.
We don\'t know GM\'s operating limits for this transmission. It rises in traffic, in hot weather and with spirited driving.
Watch the trend: if on your usual route the transmission fluid runs noticeably hotter than before, check the fluid level and condition.

string-array.name: help_gear
string-array.item: Current gear as reported by the transmission module. Formula unverified.
We expect 1–6 in forward gears. We don\'t know how the module encodes P, R and N.
If the screen shows a different gear from the actual one, the formula is wrong — send the session. The actual gear can be worked out from the gear ratio.

string-array.name: help_gear_ratio
string-array.item: Gear ratio: transmission input shaft speed divided by output shaft speed. Calculated by the app, shown only while moving.

6L50 ratios: 1st 4.065, 2nd 2.371, 3rd 1.551, 4th 1.157, 5th 0.853, 6th 0.674, reverse 3.200. At a steady pace the value should sit on one of these numbers. Intermediate values during a shift are normal.

Wanders in the same gear or rises when you press the gas — looks like clutch slip: read the TCM codes and check the transmission fluid. If it matches the table in no gear at all, the output shaft speed formula is wrong (it\'s unverified) — then send the session.

string-array.name: help_tcc_slip
string-array.item: Torque converter slip — the difference between engine speed and transmission input shaft speed.

With the TC clutch unlocked (accelerating, city), the difference is noticeable. Stopped in D on the brake, it\'s almost equal to engine RPM: the transmission shaft isn\'t turning. With the clutch locked at a steady pace, it\'s close to zero. We don\'t know GM\'s exact tolerances. On this car: 30 rpm at idle in P.
Never drops close to zero at a steady pace — the clutch doesn\'t lock. Jumps with the clutch locked — possible TC clutch wear. In both cases, read the TCM codes (e.g. P0741 — TC clutch stuck off).

string-array.name: help_input_shaft
string-array.item: Transmission input shaft speed (TC turbine). Formula verified on this car.
In P and N, slightly below engine RPM: on this car 580 at 615 engine rpm. Stopped in D on the brake: 0.
Very different from engine RPM in P/N, or drops out while driving — the input shaft speed sensor (codes P0716, P0717).

string-array.name: help_output_shaft
string-array.item: Transmission output shaft speed. Proportional to vehicle speed. Formula unverified.
0 when stopped, rises with speed. Its ratio to vehicle speed should be the same in any gear.
Checking the formula is easy: at a steady pace the gear ratio should match the 6L50 table. Drops out while driving — the output shaft speed sensor (P0722).
